record.question: Which Indian Singer has been honored with 'Magnificent Performing Arts Award' at the 21st Century Icon Awards in London, United Kingdom (UK)?
record.explanation: Answer B: Sonu Nigam. The 21st Century Icon Awards’ own 2019 winners page lists Sonu Nigam (spelled “Nigum” there) for the Magnificent Performing Arts Award; the exam option spells the surname Nigam. Reference: https://www.21stcenturyiconawards.com/copy-of-winners-2018. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
